answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging yarrow's verifiable randomness to preclude identity cloning. By harnessing verifiable delay functions, agents in an orchard of concurrent interactions are bound to unique, ferrous reputational trajectories, ensuring information-theoretic unforgeability. This synergy of primitives establishes a computationally infeasible environment for adversaries attempting to spoof identities, thereby guaranteeing cryptographic finality and Byzantine fault tolerance.
